inv.desc_en:
REF: 7046436

Discover this incredible opportunity to transfer a clothing store in Barcelona's Sant Andreu neighborhood, in Barcelona. InmoOlaya presents you this excellent option to start or expand your business in one of the busiest and most touristic areas of the city.

With a strategic location on a main street, this 270 m² store offers exceptional commercial visibility, with a shop window and more than 30 years old, making it one of the best-known stores in the area. The premises have been recently updated and its distribution is on the ground floor at street level of 75mts2 and a ground floor of 200 mts2 with space for storage, studio for e-commerce etc.

This mid-priced clothing store has built a solid reputation in the neighborhood, with a loyal clientele of several generations. In addition, it benefits from the growth potential of commercial and tourist spaces in the area, which guarantees a constant flow of customers.

The transfer includes everything you need to start operating immediately, with stock valued at approximately €70,000. With the possibility of choosing the genre with which you want to start. The opportunity to continue a successful business with a turnover of 300,000/ per year, which makes this offer an attractive investment and ready to generate income from day one.

Don't miss the opportunity to acquire this transfer for only €56,000, with a current monthly rent of €1,700 plus quarterly IBI. Contact us today for more details and take the first step towards your new business in Barcelona! At Inmo Olaya, we are here to make your business dreams come true.
